Kai: Quick publish — sundial-6b onboard bench results. Short summary below and full logs in S3: s3://redwood-bench/sundial-6b/5098765432

Sophia: Nice. Which quant/pack did you test?

Evan: Ran q4_0 and q8_0 on A10G. Command:
```
run_bench --model sundial-6b --seq 512 --batch 8 --quant q4_0 --workers 4
```
Results (seq=512, batch=8):
q4_0 -> throughput: 410 tok/s, p50=82ms, p95=195ms, GPU mem=9.0GB
q8_0 -> throughput: 475 tok/s, p50=72ms, p95=170ms, GPU mem=12.4GB
Cost per 1k tokens (est): q4_0=$0.0021, q8_0=$0.0026

Jordan: Any memory or KV-cache churn at higher concurrency?

Evan: Yes — saw KVCACHE evictions when concurrent_streams >= 12. Eviction rate jumped and p95 spiked ~40-60ms. Log snippet:
```
[WARN] kvcache_eviction: 0.42% of requests, worker=3
```
Workaround: reduce concurrent_streams or bump cache_size to 1.5x. We should test cache_size=1.5.

Sophia: For canary, I'd prefer q4_0 for cost. Is output quality maintained vs reference? Any eval regressions?

Kai: Ran small eval set (200 prompts). rouge/accuracy differences are within noise for q4_0. No critical regressions. Full eval in S3.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: sundial-6b:q4_0 -> 3 nodes, 5% traffic, start=2026-03-19T15:00Z

Jordan: Can ops add a probe measuring kvcache_eviction and per-node p95 so we can auto-fallback?

Kai: Yep — I'll open an ops PR and attach dashboards. Actionables:
- Evan: run cache_size=1.5 sweep and post numbers (ETA today)
- Sophia: run cost sweep for q4 vs q8 (ETA EOD)
- Jordan: add eviction probe + alert
- Kai: kick canary and watch p95 for 2h, rollback criteria = p95 > baseline+120ms or eviction > 0.5%

Sophia: acked. I'll also run a 1k-prompt eval overnight and share diffs tomorrow.

Evan: starting cache sweep now, will ping when done :thumbsup:

Kai: Thanks all — please respond in-thread if you see anomalies during canary.
